note: Filebrowser renders server directories as FTP-like listings. Each listing is a node of type dir_listing whose folder URI + per-node rights are stored in the module's own filebrowser_nodes table (via the filebrowser.storage service and the Drupal\filebrowser\Filebrowser value object), NOT in Fields; the file listing is cached in filebrowser_content. Global defaults for new listings live in the filebrowser.settings config object (configure route filebrowser.settings, /admin/config/system/filebrowser). Medium/hard cases are grounded in that real state: introspection reads a known folder_path off a dir_listing node and known global rights; execution creates a dir_listing node (attaching a Filebrowser object so hook_node_insert persists it) and toggles global rights, both verified against live state. NOTE: on this site the shipped field.field.node.dir_listing.body instance is missing — cases avoid relying on a Body field.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal Filebrowser module, what kind of Drupal entity represents a single browsable directory listing, and where does the module store that listing's exposed folder path?
evals.expected_output: A listing is a node of the dir_listing content type. Its exposed folder URI (folder_path) plus serialized per-node rights are stored in the module's own filebrowser_nodes database table (accessed via the filebrowser.storage service and the Drupal\filebrowser\Filebrowser value object), not as Fields.

evals.prompt: Where do I configure the global/default Filebrowser settings that new directory listings inherit, and what config object holds them?
evals.expected_output: The settings form is at /admin/config/system/filebrowser (route filebrowser.settings, permission 'administer site configuration') and the values live in the filebrowser.settings config object under the top-level 'filebrowser' key (rights, uploads, presentation, adhocsetting).

evals.prompt: Which Filebrowser permissions control viewing a listing, downloading individual files, uploading files, and downloading a whole folder as a zip archive?
evals.expected_output: view listings, download files, upload files and download archive (plus create listings, rename files, delete files, create folders, edit description). They are dynamic permissions defined by FilebrowserPermissions; none is granted by default.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a Filebrowser directory-listing node titled 'FB Known Listing'. Inspect the live site and report the folder URI (folder path) that this listing exposes.
evals.expected_output: public://fb_eval_docs — read from the filebrowser_nodes row for that node, e.g. \Drupal::service('filebrowser.storage')->loadNodeRecord($nid)['folder_path'], or $node->filebrowser->folderPath.

evals.prompt: On this site, inspect the global Filebrowser settings and report the current download method (download manager) and whether downloading a folder as a zip archive is enabled by default.
evals.expected_output: download_manager is 'public' and download_archive is 1 (enabled) — read from config filebrowser.settings under filebrowser.rights.download_manager and filebrowser.rights.download_archive.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create a Filebrowser directory listing titled 'Filebrowser Eval Share' that exposes the folder public://fb_hard. Apply it to the live site so the listing's folder is persisted.
evals.expected_output: Create a node of type dir_listing titled 'Filebrowser Eval Share', attach a Drupal\filebrowser\Filebrowser object with folder_path 'public://fb_hard' (and the rights/uploads/presentation arrays) before save so hook_node_insert() writes the filebrowser_nodes row. Verified: the filebrowser_nodes row for that node has folder_path == public://fb_hard.

evals.prompt: Change the global Filebrowser defaults on this site so that new directory listings offer a 'download all as a zip archive' option and allow exploring sub-directories. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In config filebrowser.settings set filebrowser.rights.download_archive = 1 and filebrowser.rights.explore_subdirs = 1 and save. Verified against live config.
